summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for AIS ShikkhaAI (এআইএস শিক্ষা এআই), an AI-driven NCTB and LearnLM academic transformation platform for SSC & HSC students in Bangladesh. Includes the 4-step mastery funnel (Audio Priming, Concept Drill & Mindmap, LearnLM Socratic Doubt Solver, and Diagnostic Self-Test with Mistake Vault), dual-engine evaluation architecture (Gemini 3.5 Flash + offline rubrics), and persistent 100:6:1 funnel tracking.
